 Petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed therewith, the High Court may be pleased topleased to pass an order or direction or Writ,
more specifically one in the nature of a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the respondent revenue authorities in not paying compensation of Rs 5.50 lakhs per acre as was paid to patta holders for the same acquisition and instead paying only Rs 4.20 lakhs per acre in respect of the petitioner's land of Ac 1.90 cents in survey no.
802/B1 in Gani Village of Gadivemula Mandal, Nandyal District,
Andhra pradesh in respect of the land holding of the petitioners resumed by the respondents as illegal, contrary to the settled law laid down by the honourable High Court of Andhra Pradesh in Mekala Pandu case and and as confirmed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Civil Appeal No 7904-7912 dated 04-08-2014 and consequently direct payment of the balance Rs.1.3 lakhs Per acre in respect of the land holding of the petitioner in respect of her land holding with all applicable consequential benefits including interest from the date of taking possession on 03-03-2015 and pass IA NO: 1 OF 2023  2 Gounda Ghousia Bee vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50567462/
